request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them).

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: This test expected list(todos) with no options to show completed items ("[x] milk\n[ ] eggs"). The instruction says completed todos are now hidden by default, so I changed that assertion to expect "[ ] eggs". To keep checking the show-everything output, I added an assertion that list(todos, { includeDone: true }) returns "[x] milk\n[ ] eggs".
